services.title: Our Services
services.desc: We offer state-of-the-art software solutions across diverse fields.
services.traffic_catcher_slogan: "Catch AI Traffic & Create Quality Posts in 5 Minutes!"
services.traffic_catcher_desc: An all-in-one AI automated writing solution that intelligently captures surging keywords and real-time trends across portals, OTT, and stocks to generate high-quality articles in 5 minutes.
services.games_desc: Social entertainment for everyone, delivering innovative board games and interactive party game experiences.

services.moodify_slogan: "Today's mood, the perfect soundtrack for every moment."

services.music_diffuser_desc: Official YouTube channel offering emotional AI Lo-Fi & Ambient background music curated for study, deep work, relaxation, and mindfulness.
services.uzgame_slogan: "So, what's next? Let's just start gaming! 🎮"
services.uzgame_desc: A vibrant game streaming channel delivering fun and energetic gameplay across diverse worlds. Take a break and dive into the fun!

study.title: Engineering Study
study.desc: We explore and share practical engineering workflows covering AI collaboration, modern design systems, and zero-downtime deployment.
study.card1_sub: 6-Step 30-Minute Workflow from Planning to Live Deployment
study.card1_desc: A production-grade pipeline guide showing how solo developers can rapidly build professional web services combining NotebookLM and Cloudflare Pages.
study.card2_sub: Cyberpunk Glassmorphism & 8 Curated Fonts Starter Kit
study.card2_desc: A comprehensive design system featuring reusable dark neon tokens, font comparisons (Paperlogy, etc.), ambient glow FX, and mobile safe area standards.
study.card3_sub: Conflict-Free Git Pipeline for Gemini, Codex, and Claude
study.card3_desc: Operational standards for safely integrating diverse AI agent outputs through local, staging, and production environments into one polished product.
study.card4_sub: Bulletproof Deployment Architecture Eliminating Browser/PWA Cache Issues
study.card4_desc: A reusable release pattern injecting Git Commit SHA into manifests to notify users and smoothly update client bundles without cache disruption.
study.card5_sub: One Core, Two Shells Practical Web App Architecture
study.card5_desc: An architectural standard preserving 100% mobile web/PWA stability while expanding desktop-optimized workspaces using split rendering and feature flags.
